description: Studio capture profile for the Mat_Ball baseline shot. This is the RENDER CONTRACT (light + camera + comparison mask regions), NOT material identity -- it must never enter the source-canonical material hash. A change to this file is a KB_STATIC_ASSETS tag bump = an explicit baseline-invalidation signal (see KB_PBR_Processor#500). Values seeded verbatim from the omniverse_capture_material.py constants at processor commit 295eedd (behaviour-preserving).

resolution.note: baseline studio shot dims; actual capture resolution is set by the job request (CLI default 1024). Informational here, not applied.

mask_regions.note: studio 1920x1080 region masks for region-aware SSIM (KB_PBR_Processor#499/#500). ball=material signal, sky=light/env stability, checkerboard=informational (cross-platform render-noise floor).
